metadata.name: Dad's Key Additions (+Soul of Cain)
metadata.description:
This mod adds additional behavior for Dad's Key and Soul of Cain.
Dad's Key will additionally open: [list] [*]locked chests - golden, eternal, old, and mega chests (eternal chests can re-close) [*]bomb chests - dad's key can open bombable doors [*]key blocks - rgon+ recommended but not required [*]strange door - polaroid door to the ascent (soul of cain already does this) [*]flesh door - knife door to the corpse (soul of cain already does this) [/list]
Get out of Jail Free Card is also supported since it triggers Dad's Key.
Soul of Cain will additionally open: [list] [*]mirror - fix instead of break the mirror to the mirror dimension [*]boss rush - open the door to boss rush even if you're past 20 minutes (after mom is defeated) [*]blue womb - open the door to hush even if you're past 30 minutes (after mom's heart is defeated) [*]devil door - open a devil/angel room door even if the devil percent is zero (after boss is defeated) [/list]
On XL floors, the new boss room behavior only works in the 2nd boss room. Doors spawned in boss rooms likely won't stay open. Once you leave the room, normal rules will apply.
The additional soul of cain behavior can also be enabled for dad's key. Mod Config Menu is required to change your settings.
Note: devil door behavior is disabled in ???, The Void, and Home.
Chest/block behavior is unique to Dad's Key. Red room behavior is unique to Soul of Cain.
